in_sanskrit.name: Shakshavali
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Fortitude
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shakshavali एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Shakshavali is derived from the Sanskrit language and refers to the Goddess of Fortitude. It is believed that this name embodies the strength and courage of the divine feminine, providing protection and support to those who carry it.
